name: Role and Group Model
description: Roles are collections of capabilities. Groups are collections of principals. Assign roles to groups. Both roles and groups are scoped to an organization or team.
purpose: Decouple who from what — assign capabilities through roles, and principals through groups, so authorization logic composes cleanly.
acceptanceCriteria: Role entity defined as a set of capability identifiers
Group entity defined as a set of principal references
Role-to-group assignment: one role per group, multiple groups per principal
Capability resolution: given a principal, resolve all capabilities through group->role chain
Built-in roles defined: admin, member, viewer, custom
Role and group definitions are receipted and auditable
Scoped to organization or team — roles/groups from different scopes do not leak
